capabilities: Carry yesterday's unfinished tasks into today's daily note
Mark aging tasks with orange and red warnings
Drop tasks past a business-day threshold into a monthly drop document
Log completed tasks into a monthly summary document
Render a monthly Gantt timeline of task status
disambiguation: Despite the name, it only manages task lines in daily notes — it assumes daily notes are your task ledger and moves files when dropping or archiving.
extras: Installable as beta via BRAT or manually from releases; note file contents (section headers, suffixes, summaries) always stay in Korean format regardless of the UI language setting; drop and archive actually move files; offers dry-run and environment diagnostics commands; development details are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
problem: Obsidian daily notes don't automatically carry unfinished tasks to the next day or age out tasks that linger uncompleted.

relations.evidence: If you only want carryover, Rollover Daily Todos is lighter.
Query-based tools like Tasks fit better.

summary: Automates the daily-note task lifecycle: carries unfinished tasks forward, warns on aging, drops stale ones, and logs completions in monthly summaries.
